name: vscode-alijunior-project-switcher
description: Switch between open VSCode windows from the status bar: pinned projects, most recent ones on hover, and per-project name, color and icon

commands.title: Switch Projects: Go to Last Project

enumDescriptions: Clicking the status bar item opens the full window picker.
Clicking the status bar item jumps straight to the last used project.
switchProjects.clickAction.description: What happens when the status bar item is clicked. The hover always offers the other one: with 'picker', the hover ends with the last active project; with 'last', it ends with the picker.

switchProjects.projectSettings.description: Per-project overrides, keyed by absolute project path. Easier to edit through the 'Switch Projects: Configure Current Project' command than by hand.

name.description: Display name. The real folder name is kept as a suffix in the hover list.

color.description: Hex value or theme color id. Overrides switchProjects.statusBarColor for this project.

icon.description: Codicon id shown before the project name.

order.description: Position among pinned projects. Pinned projects without an order fall behind, alphabetically.

pinned.description: When true, the project is always listed in the Pinned section of the hover.

switchProjects.recentCount.description: How many recently used projects are listed when hovering the status bar item. Pinned projects don't take these slots. Set to 0 to turn the hover off — the item then shows only the current project name and clicking it opens the picker.

switchProjects.statusBarColor.description: Default color of the status bar item, used when the project has no color of its own. Accepts a hex value (#FFD700) or a theme color id (statusBarItem.warningForeground). Leave empty to use the status bar default color.

switchProjects.palette.description: List of icons used to color projects in the picker (assigned by alphabetical position).

switchProjects.currentIcon.description: Icon shown for the currently active project in the picker.

switchProjects.pinCurrentFirst.description: When true, the current project is always shown first in the picker. When false, it stays in alphabetical order.
